figmaRebuildRules.containerPlacement: For a multi-screen container: sibling row `{container.name} — OneUI` at y = container.y + container.height + 120; shells sorted by source x
figmaRebuildRules.height: HUG vertical auto-layout (container shells may stay FIXED 800 to match sources)
figmaRebuildRules.themeOnRoot: Apply 13.1 Theme range + 13.2/13.3 brand Theme modes on the root frame
figmaRebuildRules.gaps: When status is design_create, annotate a [GAP] frame and use documented fallback — never invent a published component

figmaRebuildRules.layoutParity: Clone source frame into OneUI slot (same 360x800, padding, rhythm); do not freehand restack
figmaRebuildRules.imagesFromSource: Preserve every IMAGE imageHash + vector/logo groups from the source frame
